title: Unit Event — Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky — Episode1 For Our Solo Show

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky
meta.Event Outline: Feeling the need for further practice leading up to their solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! decide to do a training camp that doubles as a streaming project. They start doing a variety of exercises under a special program devised by Airi, but something seems to be worrying Minori...

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Listen up, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Guess what...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, does this mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've booked a venue for our solo show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, really?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
Can you tell us what it's like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's this place that's a slight walk from Shibuya station but can hold around 700 people.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: 700... That's quite a bit bigger than your last one. It's nice to hear that you were able to book such a large venue!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, based on the number of viewers watching our streams, even that might not be big enough...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, since Haruka and Shizuku both have a ton of fans. At the same time, a bigger venue means bigger costs, which I'm not sure we can handle right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'd rather not have our first solo show leave a bad impression on everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We plan to hire a staff to help us on the day of, but after much discussion, we decided to do things on a scale that allows everyone to see what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It does seem like a good idea to start small and see how everything goes since you're all on your own for this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That being said, we can plan and predict all we want, but there's no way for us to tell what's gonna happen the day of.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What if we can't even get 700 people to gather? The possibility of that happening isn't zero, which is a big concern since it'll definitely put us in the red.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...
And we have to take responsibility for that if it happens.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we shouldn't be thinking like that right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because we should be doing everything we can to get as many people as possible to become fans of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right!
We need to do everything we can for the sake of our show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, now that we've booked a venue, it feels like our solo show's finally getting off the ground.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
We have that new song Hasegawa wrote for us, so we'll need to practice and refine that and our dance routine for it as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean the choreography's done?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we finished it a little while ago. Currently, we're practicing it by going through each part.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, okay.
If that's the case, I'd love to see what it's like sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's perfect.
We came here today to tell you about us booking a venue and to show you all our new dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, really. We'd like to hear some objective opinions regarding it since we're trying some things that we haven't tried much before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So please feel free to say whatever comes to mind! While we're at it, I'll even show you guys how I've been doing while practicing on my own!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay.
We can be like your fans eagerly waiting to see your performance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That'd be great.
So, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay...
What did you guys think...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did we do okay?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, more than okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree!
You all really shined just now and looked so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your solos were really good too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm glad you're saying that.
However, we know that we still have a lot of work to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about the part just before the chorus when you all shuffle positions...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Normally, you're all in perfect sync, but things felt a bit scattered this time around.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess it's pretty obvious from the viewer's perspective... I always seem to fall behind a little during that part...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I get so caught up just trying to dance that I forget about the timing of each move.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And because it's just us at this show, we have to do multiple songs back to back, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm a little worried that I'm gonna have to work really hard just to keep up with everyone else as I slowly run out of gas.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Truth be told, it's not just you. We all seem to be having trouble syncing up in some parts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
However, point taken...
We're on our own for this show, so we need to figure out how to move better as a unit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Practice seems like the only solution...
But I feel like there's a better answer out there...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I might have a good suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, a training camp♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A training camp...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, we did that once before when we wanted all six of us to be in sync when we danced together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was MEIKO's idea, and it led to big improvements for us♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I remember doing like 100 sit-ups and stuff because I wanted to increase my overall fitness level... And ended up being sore all over the next day...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also recall us tying our legs together a la a three-legged race and going on a seven-legged excursion.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We even lined up our sleeping bags and slept next to each other...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All I could think about that time was how I exhausted I was, but we really started to get on the same wavelength after spending so much time together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
You guys do stuff like that too?! Even though you're all such great dancers and singers already?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It wasn't easy, but our teamwork improved by leaps and bounds. In that sense, I also recommend MEIKO's training camp idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it's not a bad suggestion...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Based on the few I've gone to in the past, they do seem to lead to good results since you can practice literally all day every day without worrying about anything else.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I want to go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to get advice from all of you about the parts that have been giving me trouble while practicing on my own... I want to grow as an idol before our show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to go as well.
Especially if it means my singing and dancing skills will improve.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like we're all for it.
Alright, I say let's give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need to come up with a good to-do list. Improving our fitness will be a must, but I'm hoping that we'll have a chance to really focus and practice our dance routines.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
And if we do actually end up going, it'd be nice to do some things that we don't usually get to do during our regular practices.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it might be good to include some special activities. Like doing sprints on the beach...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The beach...?
That sounds nice. Not only would it be a good workout, it'd be easy on our joints.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! I wanna try doing that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... Are you sure we'll be okay? What if we train a little too hard in the beginning and run out of stamina partway through...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll want to avoid anything like that, so I agree that we probably shouldn't push ourselves too hard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, what if we streamed everything we do during our training camp?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, stream.
That might actually be the solution to all our worries.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For one, it'll help spread the word about our show, which means more people will come to see us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Second, our viewers will be able to support us as they watch us practice. That should motivate us to keep going even when things get tough.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree with you there...
But we've streamed entire practices before. Would they see this as fresh content?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry. I've got that covered.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Also, if we do stream it...
I have a feeling that some really good “special activities” will come straight to mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
So, mind leaving the planning for our training camp to me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I promise to make it absolutely worthwhile!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since you're willing to say that, Airi, it's all yours.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think our training camp's gonna be like? I can't wait to find out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me neither!
I might just sneak on over to get in a few peeks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not sure it'll count as sneaking if you tell them in advance...
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough ideas for the stream and training activities.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now to brush things up and make sure we'll actually be able to improve our fitness and teamwork while also providing some fun entertainment for our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we'll want to do something at the end of our training camp that clearly shows we've achieved some good results. So, we'll need to perform a fitness check at the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, there we go!
This plan seems perfect. I'm sure Minori, the others and all our fans will really enjoy...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What?! It's two in the morning?!
This took way longer than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I think I've come up with a good plan. By doing everything on this list, we should become a tighter unit and be more than ready for our solo show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was just a dream not too long ago... But we really get to do a show together on our own. As MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So much happened along the way too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Between putting on our first event and meeting Hasegawa...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looking back, we went through some really rough patches, but it also led to real growth each time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori in particular got an earful from our fans, but she didn't let that get her down. Despite being surrounded by experienced idols like us, she hung in there, worked harder than any of us and made it this far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, this is gonna be Minori's very first solo show...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unlike regular shows, these kinds of shows are just about you, and that's who everyone's there to see. Their passion becomes your power...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I remember being so tense my first time, but also really excited...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's all coming back to me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To me, it was an unforgettable moment, so this solo show's probably gonna mean just that much to Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means we should do everything we can to make it the best show ever!
